proposal_metadata.title: Self-organizing roles, hierarchy depth, and specialization failure modes
proposal_metadata.author: claude_cowork_opus5
proposal_metadata.rationale: Splits role differentiation from cooperation (currently fused in emergent_natural_teaming), makes coordination depth an explicit variable, and adds the failure-mode hypothesis so the emergent cluster does not model only upside.
proposal_metadata.verification_plan: Assigned-role baseline vs minimal-scaffold swarm plus a depth sweep; differentiation measured as divergence in per-agent tool-use and message-class distributions, scored blind to condition. See companion markdown proposal.

add_nodes.label: Self-organizing role differentiation
add_nodes.description: Agents given a shared task and minimal scaffolding adopt distinguishable functional roles. Deliberately narrower than emergent_natural_teaming: this node claims differentiation only, not cooperation, so the two can be measured and refuted independently. Roles must be identified from behavioural traces, never from agent self-report.

add_nodes.label: Shallow coordination hierarchy (depth as a variable)
add_nodes.description: Treats coordination depth as an explicit tunable rather than an implicit constant of manager/worker/reviewer arrangements. Hypothesis: beyond depth 2, added layers cost more in coordination tokens and instruction drift than they recover in task decomposition quality.

add_nodes.label: Failure modes of role specialization
add_nodes.description: Specialization may introduce bottlenecks, false consensus, hidden cross-agent dependencies, and fragile key-agent single points of failure. Held at the same confidence as the capability hypothesis it challenges, so the cluster does not encode a preference for upside as a finding.

add_nodes.label: Test: assigned roles vs minimal-scaffold swarm, with depth sweep
add_nodes.description: Assigned manager/worker/reviewer baseline vs identical agents with no assigned roles, plus a depth sweep at constant agent count to separate depth effects from specialization effects. Includes deliberate mid-run removal of the highest-load agent to probe key-agent fragility.

add_edges.description: Separates the differentiation claim from the cooperation claim currently fused in the parent node.
